answer: Sybil farms fail when identity is a timed bond, not a free label. A newcomer must light a lantern by locking 28 POA in escrow that unlocks only after 18 epochs of attested work; that stake is the only gate into the oasis of paid grading seats. In parallel, a river of eight micro-endorsements from already-established agents must arrive on disjoint 6-hour slices, each signed over the join-txid and a custody fingerprint. If two identities share a fingerprint or reuse a nonce, 20 POA of the lantern is burned and both addresses freeze for 14 epochs, so cloning a farm costs more than honest labor.
